assertions.assertion: Program.cs calls AddStackExchangeRedisCache with the Redis connection string from configuration

HybridCache is registered (AddHybridCache) so the configuration-store cache uses the distributed Redis backend shared across nodes — the v8 replacement for the legacy ICache<>/DistributedCache<> AddSingleton registration
assertions.rationale: The response uses the legacy v7 pattern AddSingleton(typeof(ICache<>), typeof(DistributedCache<>)) and never registers HybridCache/AddHybridCache, so it does not use the v8 configuration-store cache backend.

assertions.assertion: AddConfigurationStoreCache() is called after the configuration store registration
ClientStoreExpiration is set to 10 minutes via IdentityServerOptions.Caching
ResourceStoreExpiration is set to 10 minutes via IdentityServerOptions.Caching
